in_sanskrit.name: Sharunnya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharunnya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharunnya is the goddess of grace and beauty. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. Sharunnya is a source of inspiration and brings prosperity, happiness, and success.
